models.preferred_precision: official model/default precision; MLX on Apple Silicon when available, GPU runtime on CUDA, CPU only as fallback; no official 8-bit artifact reviewed
models.notes: Recommended only as the current technically working local path through the official upstream runtime adapter, which uses the 5Hz LM music planner. AbstractMusic defaults to the bundled 1.7B 5Hz LM; the 0.6B LM remains selectable but lower quality. The default turbo DiT does not use CFG, so guidance is treated as unsupported unless a non-turbo DiT is explicitly configured. Short instrumental generations are quality-limited and can be highly repetitive, so this provider still needs a repetition/novelty gate before being treated as production-quality. The older packaged custom backend produced valid PCM but failed the music-quality smoke as fast rotor-like audio and remains non-recommended.

models.preferred_precision: official safetensors/pytorch weights; no official 8-bit artifact reviewed, so prefer official 16-bit/float loading where supported
models.notes: Small 300M text-to-music baseline with a simple Transformers path. Non-commercial weights, so it is a validation/comparison provider rather than a production default. AbstractMusic provides an optional backend through the musicgen extra.

models.preferred_precision: official checkpoint only; no official 8-bit artifact reviewed
models.notes: Small 341M gated text-to-audio model optimized for short clips and Arm CPUs. Likely useful for sound effects and short loops; model card cautions that music generation can be poor quality. AbstractMusic provides an optional backend through the stable-audio extra, but model loading requires Hugging Face access approval.

models.preferred_precision: official Diffusers checkpoint dtype; prefer 16-bit/bf16 where supported because no official 8-bit artifact is available
models.notes: Preferred clean XL provider candidate using Diffusers AceStepPipeline. Adapter is implemented; real smoke validation is still required.

models.preferred_precision: official sharded safetensors; no official 8-bit artifact reviewed
models.notes: Raw XL Turbo DiT checkpoint. Not a complete minimal pipeline by itself; prefer the Diffusers conversion for AbstractMusic.

models.preferred_precision: official sharded safetensors; no official 8-bit artifact reviewed
models.notes: Raw XL SFT quality variant with CFG/APG. Heavy future provider candidate, not minimal base.

models.preferred_precision: HeartMuLa bf16 and HeartCodec fp32 per official local deployment docs when no official 8-bit artifact is available
models.notes: Lyrics and tags conditioned music model. Requires HeartCodec checkpoint and official heartlib runtime; heavy optional provider candidate.

models.preferred_precision: official sharded safetensors; no official 8-bit artifact reviewed, so prefer official 16-bit when supported
models.notes: YuE Stage-1 semantic-token model. It is music-related but not an end-to-end audio checkpoint by itself; a usable provider needs the official YuE Stage-2 model, upsampler/codec path, and real audio validation.

models.preferred_precision: official model.pt only; license must be resolved before provider work
models.notes: Small unconditional classical piano MIDI generator. Not prompt-conditioned despite text-to-audio tag.

models.preferred_precision: official ckpt stack only; non-commercial and not a default provider
models.notes: Multimodal audio/foley research provider. Non-commercial license and heavy CUDA/script stack.
